notes.title: Game Update: steam items and game fixes
notes.content:
Game Update:
[olist]
[*] 50 Steam Items Added: The first item will drop after 60 minutes of gameplay, with subsequent drops occurring every 60 minutes. Clicking is not required for item drops.
[*] Fixed Several Game Crashes: We've addressed multiple issues that were causing the game to crash.
[*] Achievements Coming Soon: Achievements will be added shortly, once we gather some additional information.
[/olist]
